blocks.text: If you encounter an issue when attempting to access a Browser Access-enabled application, the end user notification (EUN) includes the error code. For example:

The EUN heading (e.g., ZPA BA: Proxy loop detected) is a hyperlink which leads you to the Zscaler Help Portal for more information. The HTTP status code is always displayed. This information also appears on Diagnostics pages.
To learn more about Private Access error and policy block codes, including possible resolutions, see Understanding Private Access Session Status Codes.
